passive.name: Emberblood

passive.name: Stoneheart
passive.description: The first stagger or root effect each encounter is shortened.

passive.name: Adaptive Spark

passive.name: Verdant Focus
passive.description: Regeneration and cleansing effects are stronger.

passive.name: Colossus Frame
passive.description: Maximum HP is increased, but spell costs are slightly higher.

passive.name: Mireborn Renewal
passive.description: Damage-over-time healing and regeneration are improved.

fire+arcane.name: Cinderstar Convergence
fire+arcane.description: Fire and arcane effects alternate, granting bonus spell power after an elemental hit.

earth+water.name: Mirestone Continuum
earth+water.description: Earth defenses and water regeneration reinforce one another.

shadow+arcane.name: Umbral Astralism
shadow+arcane.description: Shadow and arcane abilities can veil the caster after a critical spell.

fire+earth.name: Forgeheart Symbiosis
fire+earth.description: Fire offense is stabilized by earth resilience.

shadow+water.name: Duskfen Veil
shadow+water.description: The lineage thrives in blighted environments and converts control into regeneration.
